name: lake_superior_etopo_full_lake
estimate_basis: Conservative 128 MiB cap for two request-bounded NOAA ETOPO 2022 OPeNDAP slabs and local NetCDF products; the final 15 arc-second grid is approximately 1.35 million cells.
vertical_datum_policy: ETOPO elevation is EGM2008; convert to positive-down depth using Lake Superior LWD 183.2 m IGLD 1985 without claiming a vertical datum transformation.
